purpose: Provide a payment service API (PaymentGateway) with authorization and refund operations, a structured receipt type (PaymentReceipt), and a domain-specific error (PaymentError) for payment failures.
components: PaymentGateway: service class exposing authorize(customer, amount_cents) -> PaymentReceipt and refund(customer, receipt) -> None; tracks authorized_total_cents and refunded_total_cents
PaymentReceipt: dataclass value object carrying payment_id, amount_cents, provider
PaymentError: domain-specific exception type for payment operations
internal_structure: The module centers on PaymentGateway, which coordinates payment authorization and refunds by delegating balance changes to Customer, constructing PaymentReceipt records, and signaling failures via PaymentError. PaymentReceipt carries structured result data, and PaymentError defines the boundary for payment-related exceptions.
module_mechanism: Consumers import PaymentGateway, instantiate it with an optional provider label, and call authorize or refund. Internally, the gateway validates amounts, interacts with Customer.debit/credit, uses uuid4/str to tag receipts, returns PaymentReceipt on authorization, and accumulates authorized/refunded totals on the instance. Other modules (e.g., CLI builder and OrderService._charge) rely on these operations.
key_paths: authorize -> validate positive amount -> <SPL>commerce_ops_demo.commerce_ops.models.Customer.debit</SPL> -> create receipt id via uuid4/str -> return <SPL>commerce_ops_demo.commerce_ops.payments.PaymentReceipt</SPL>
refund -> validate positive receipt amount -> <SPL>commerce_ops_demo.commerce_ops.models.Customer.credit</SPL> -> update refunded_total_cents -> no return
Used by: commerce_ops_demo.commerce_ops.services.OrderService._charge -> PaymentGateway.authorize; CLI builder constructs/uses PaymentGateway
errors: <SPL>commerce_ops_demo.commerce_ops.payments.PaymentError</SPL>: 'amount must be positive' when amount_cents <= 0 in authorize
<SPL>commerce_ops_demo.commerce_ops.payments.PaymentError</SPL>: 'receipt amount must be positive' when receipt.amount_cents <= 0 in refund
summary: Provide a payment service API (PaymentGateway) with authorization and refund operations, a structured receipt type (PaymentReceipt), and a domain-specific error (PaymentError) for payment failures.
